Politics · India

E20 fuel sparks debate over vehicle compatibility and government claims

Union Minister Nitin Gadkari challenged critics to name a vehicle damaged by E20 fuel, while also stating it is used in racing cars. Concerns have been raised by the public and industry bodies regarding potential damage to vehicles and reduced mileage. A 2021 NITI Aayog report highlighted SIAM's concerns about continuing E10 fuel alongside E20.
